Here is a professional transcription of the 1857 Latin marriage register entries visible in **image_e16e28.png**.

Because historical parish registers often contain standard abbreviations, shorthand, and varying legibility, this transcription keeps the original spellings and structures as written, breaking them down entry-by-entry across the left and right pages.
